Upcoming meeting

Our next Council meeting is on Monday 19 October 2026 at 6 pm. 

The meeting will be streamed live online, so you can watch proceedings as they happen. Meeting agendas and minutes are also published on this page when available. The agendas are usually published by close of business on the Tuesday prior to the meeting.
